items.raw_excerpt: Aboriginal leaders in WA's north have urged the state government to provide more support for fetal alcohol spectrum disorder.
items.summary_en: Aboriginal leaders in northern Western Australia have asked the state government to give more support for fetal alcohol spectrum disorder (FASD). They say families in the Kimberley region need more help. They are asking for earlier diagnosis and better services close to home.
